title: Quaint Fluffy Brazilian Chorizo Casserole
description: A funky and comforting Brazilian dish featuring chorizo, this casserole is perfect for a chilly evening, and is jain-friendly as it contains no animal by-products other than the chorizo which can be substituted with a jain-friendly alternative
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until it is tender.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until it is tender.
Add the cooked rice, black beans, vegetable broth, cumin, and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chorizo to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
